indirect_reasons: Spiritual Overflow nerfed (spirit 40->30, fire rate 30->25%, slower buildup) hits his burn-gun build; Toxic Bullets spirit scaling 0.005->0.006 is a small offset.
Comeback gutting punishes his late-scaler half, while dashes/light melee no longer pausing the gun cycle is a free gun-weaving buff.
build_changes: Lean Dashfernus; if gun, move off Spiritual Overflow toward Toxic Bullets/Swift Striker.
heroes.one_liner: Gun build lost its capstone; Dashfernus and the Toxic Bullets buff carry him.

indirect_reasons: Cultist Sacrifice bounty 180->170% trims his farm-bankroll opener.
Gutted comeback souls hit the farm-first scaler hardest, and the Hollow Point buff is irrelevant to his spirit build.
heroes.one_liner: Farm-scaler nerfed twice over: smaller Cultist payout, no comeback net.

indirect_reasons: Flyer tax: global slows now bite air drag and Silver's Weighted Bola grounds/interrupts flyers.
Poke/siege is flagged down in a tempo meta, with no item change helping her.
build_changes: Slot Counterspell/anti-dive earlier; expect to be grounded more often.
heroes.one_liner: Anti-air patch grounds the flyer; the S read was always generous.

direct_reasons: Life Drain T3 spirit scaling +0.3->+0.45 and Essence Bomb T3 damage 26->30% buff her bomb/drain burst.
indirect_reasons: Radiant Regeneration per-boon scaling 2->1.7 trims her 98%-buy sustain core.
Comeback gutting punishes her 0-6-then-farm pattern, capping the rise.
heroes.one_liner: Bomb and drain got better, but her regen stack and comeback pattern took hits.

direct_reasons: Infernal Resilience T3 +8->+9% and Seismic Impact T3 Unstoppable 6s->5s roughly wash.
indirect_reasons: Fortitude max-health regen 2->2.25% buffs his default survivability slot.
Dashes/light melee no longer break gun cycle helps his melee-gun weave; Decay anti-heal still caps Siphon.
heroes.one_liner: Healthy frontline in a brawl patch; a touch more resilience, a touch less ult.

direct_reasons: Card Trick heal 75->60, heal spirit scaling 0.75->0.5, resist shred -8->-7% (T3 -5->-4%) and T3 Clubs slow +20->+15% all cut.
indirect_reasons: Mercurial Magnum nerfed (bullet 25->20%, scaling 0.49->0.38) and Plated Armor now blocks Full Auto's spirit damage outright.
Spiritual Overflow nerf finishes the on-hit spirit package.
build_changes: Abandon the Mercurial Magnum/on-hit-spirit core; rebuild toward pure gun or utility and respect Plated Armor buyers.
heroes.one_liner: On-hit spirit Wraith gutted: Magnum cut and Plated Armor now blanks Full Auto.

indirect_reasons: Global slows -20% weakens her wall/Suppressor zoning.
Guardian bounty +10% rewards her lane siege, so the two roughly offset.
heroes.one_liner: Turret siege still fine; her zoning slows got softer.

direct_reasons: Kinetic Carbine min-damage multiplier 25->10% and no longer scaled by T3 kills the cheap quick-scope poke.
indirect_reasons: Slowing Hex cd 27->29s trims her pick setup, and the tempo meta keeps punishing a stationary sniper.
build_changes: Commit to the max-range HVR/Sharpshooter sniper line; the min-damage carbine poke is gone.
heroes.one_liner: Quick-scope carbine gutted; only the max-range sniper path survives.

indirect_reasons: Tempo/initiation meta rewards Singularity picks, and Diviner's Kevlar now adds +10% ultimate CDR for ult-reliant tanks.
Slowing Hex cd nerf is a minor tax.
build_changes: Diviner's Kevlar is now a live buy purely for ult uptime.
heroes.one_liner: Tempo initiator whose Kevlar now doubles as ult-CDR.

direct_reasons: Frozen Shelter base regen now scales with spirit power (0.2), so early spirit buys heal more.
indirect_reasons: Broad healing-item trims (Radiant Regeneration, Restorative Locket) hit others more than his Extra Regen/Healing Booster core.
heroes.one_liner: Dome now scales with spirit; cheap early sustain is worth more.

direct_reasons: Fixation headshot stacks +2->+3 and T3 weapon scaling 0.0003->0.00035 lift her early-mid damage.
indirect_reasons: Gun-cycle smoothing (dash/light melee no longer pause the gun) helps her M1 tempo.
T4 gun items stay weak and Plated Armor blocks on-hit spirit, capping her scaling.
heroes.one_liner: Fixation buff is real; weak T4 gun items still cap her ceiling.

direct_reasons: Crackshot T2 adds -6% bullet res for 5s, health/boon 41->43, and Bounce Pad extends Lasso +1->+1.25s.
indirect_reasons: Tempo plus the longer 20m respawn (35->38s) make Lasso picks worth more.
Veil Walker lost Sprint Boots/movespeed-on-break, stripping her core disengage.
build_changes: Find a new disengage now that Veil Walker is stripped.
heroes.one_liner: Tempo and longer lasso picks suit her, but her Veil Walker bail-out is gone.

indirect_reasons: Veil Walker (77% core) lost Sprint Boots and movespeed-on-break, stripping his dive cover.
Slowing Hex cd 27->29s and global slows -20% both weaken his hook-lock chain.
heroes.one_liner: Hook combo intact, but Veil Walker cover and his slows both got trimmed.

indirect_reasons: Tempo/lane-wins economy plays directly to her early snowball.
Her melee-spirit core items are untouched by the patch.
heroes.one_liner: Tempo meta is tailor-made for her early dive snowball.

indirect_reasons: Flyer: air-drag slows plus Silver's Weighted Bola grounding hurt his uptime.
Poke/siege archetype is down in a tempo meta with no item help.
heroes.one_liner: Anti-air tempo patch keeps the flyer poke carry stuck at C.

indirect_reasons: Trophy Collector souls/min 18->16 trims his early tempo opener.
The brawl meta and untouched tank items keep him competitive.
heroes.one_liner: Early brawler in a brawl patch; just a smaller Trophy Collector trickle.

direct_reasons: Alt fire base damage +4% and per-boon +0.2->+0.24, and Serrated Knives now deals 3.5% current-HP on impact at full rage.
indirect_reasons: Radiant Regeneration (97% core) and Restorative Locket trims hit his regen stack, and Tankbuster 8->7.5% softens his anti-tank slot.
heroes.one_liner: Knives and alt-fire buffed into the tank wave, but his regen items were trimmed.

direct_reasons: Stone Form radius 6->5.75m and T1 max-health heal 7->6% are small trims.
indirect_reasons: Healing-item trims and a tempo meta punishing her weak lane expose the A-tier support; her gun-first core is otherwise untouched.
heroes.one_liner: Cosmetic Stone Form trims, but the tempo patch makes her weak lane hurt.

direct_reasons: Bullet dmg/boon 0.28->0.25, fire-rate spirit scaling 0.25->0.21, Alchemical Flask range/speed -30%, Willpower T3 spirit scaling +2.7->+2.1 and debuff resist 40->30%.
indirect_reasons: Mercurial Magnum and Spiritual Overflow, his two T4 finishers, were both nerfed.
Veil Walker lost Sprint Boots, weakening his cage-bruiser shell.
build_changes: Skip the gutted Mercurial Magnum/Spiritual Overflow finishers; the gun line needs a new ceiling.
heroes.one_liner: Patch's clearest casualty: gun stats, flask, cage and T4 items all cut.

direct_reasons: Crimson Slash T3 adds +0.4 heal spirit scaling and Flying Slash light-melee scaling rises 1.0->1.2.
indirect_reasons: Tankbuster 8->7.5% trims her late anti-tank luxury; the tempo/Refresher-Unstoppable windows still suit her.
heroes.one_liner: Light-melee and heal scaling up; mobile burst assassin stays A.

direct_reasons: Ground Strike T3 spirit scaling +0.03->+0.04 and per-meter damage 110->120% push him onto the stomp build; gun falloff 18-54->16-48m and Grapple T2 buff duration 10->6s hurt gun Lash.
indirect_reasons: Silver's Weighted Bola grounds/interrupts his airborne engage and air-drag slows tax him.
Flog heal 50->40% plus healing-item trims cut his sustain.
build_changes: Drop gun Lash; play the stomp/spirit build the Ground Strike buffs enable.
heroes.one_liner: Stomp build buffed and still the lobby default, but Silver grounds his engage.

direct_reasons: Cube cast range 26->20m, Puddle Punch cd 21->24s, alt-fire damage growth -10% and Splatter T1 +2->+1.5m all trim his tools; Splatter cd 0.15->0.12 and Goo Ball T3 spirit scaling +0.2 are partial offsets.
indirect_reasons: Veil Walker lost Sprint Boots, weakening his cooldown-Cube support shell, and the tempo meta punishes a scaling enabler.
heroes.one_liner: Cube range and Punch cooldown cut; tempo punishes the scaling enabler.

indirect_reasons: Comeback gutting removes the safety net his Affliction late burst needs.
Cultist Sacrifice nerf trims his farm item, and the tempo meta closes games before he scales.
heroes.one_liner: Late Affliction carry with no comeback net in a tempo meta.

indirect_reasons: Comeback gutting punishes his slow split-push scaling map play.
Toxic Bullets buff (his on-hit core) is a small offset, but the tempo meta ends games early.
heroes.one_liner: Split-push scaler punished hardest by the gutted comeback souls.

direct_reasons: Slither T3 barrier 5->4s and Petrifying Bola cd 105->115s are small on their own.
indirect_reasons: Mercurial Magnum (93% capstone) nerfed and Plated Armor now blocks her spirit-amp/Tesla on-hit damage.
Spiritual Overflow nerf removes the on-hit package she splices in.
build_changes: Pivot to pure gun (Close Quarters/Split Shot/Burst Fire); the Mercurial Magnum splice is now blocked.
heroes.one_liner: Her Magnum capstone gutted and Plated Armor hard-counters the splice.

indirect_reasons: Tempo divers (Yamato, Lash, Drifter) that beat him got stronger.
No item change helps his duration/cooldown spirit build.
heroes.one_liner: Kit-steal coin-flip in a meta that favors the divers who beat him.

indirect_reasons: Tempo/tank meta eats her single-target burst and Yamato owns her mobile-assassin niche.
No item change lifts her spirit-burst build.
heroes.one_liner: Burst assassin crowded out by Yamato; tanks eat her rotation.

indirect_reasons: Trophy Collector souls/min 18->16 and the Veil Walker nerf trim his secondary anti-heal build.
The tempo/early-bruiser meta and untouched melee core keep his floor high.
heroes.one_liner: Early melee bruiser built for the tempo patch; only a small Trophy Collector trim.

direct_reasons: Ira Domini now works with Ricochet (all shots bounce) and can split-shot into 3 bolts, raising his late ceiling.
indirect_reasons: Weakening Headshot -13->-12% is a small relative loss against Hollow Point buyers.
Battle Vest and his vitality items are untouched.
heroes.one_liner: Ult now chains Ricochet and triple-bolts; the better gun-carry slot over Haze.
Fair baseline tank, essentially untouched by the patch.

direct_reasons: Heavy Melee spirit scaling 0.3->0.45, Captivating Read T1 -11->-14s and T3 +1m->+2m buff her lane and CC.
indirect_reasons: Tempo/lane-wins economy rewards her snowball-a-carry play, and anti-flyer shifts remove threats she feared.
Slowing Hex cd nerf is a minor tax.
heroes.one_liner: Lane-winning support the new economy is built for; talents buffed.

indirect_reasons: Veil Walker nerf weakens his kidnap/escape shell.
The tempo meta beats his delayed setup, and his low-WR Vortex Web/Slowing Hex staples are unchanged.
heroes.one_liner: Delayed setup initiator loses to the tempo the patch rewards.

indirect_reasons: Lifestrike melee heal buffed (120+1.75, 35% healing) and its slow now drags flyers, which he spams.
Fortitude regen buff and a lane-bully tempo meta suit him; rising anti-tank Shiv is the risk.
heroes.one_liner: Lane-bully frontline with a buffed Lifestrike; Shiv rising is the only worry.

direct_reasons: Health per boon 33->35 is a small survivability buff.
indirect_reasons: Comeback gutting deletes the safety net her ~25-min scaling game relied on.
Toxic Bullets buff slightly helps her on-hit line, but dive assassins got stronger.
heroes.one_liner: Small HP buff, but losing the comeback net hurts the game's worst early carry.

indirect_reasons: Comeback gutting plus the early-Rift resist nerf make his win-lane/invade/escape tempo convert to wins; the spirit item pool is untouched.
Restorative Locket nerf only trims his secondary support line.
heroes.one_liner: Archetype winner of the tempo patch; only his Locket support line got trimmed.

direct_reasons: Only a Lil Helpers target-UI change and a breakable-spawn bug fix — no balance effect.
indirect_reasons: Healing-item trims slightly weaken his heal niche, and Ivy outclasses his support slot.
heroes.one_liner: No real change; a heal support in a patch that trims healing items.

direct_reasons: Health/boon 28->31, sprint speed 1.5->2.5, and Weighted Bola now increases gravity and interrupts flying abilities (anti-air).
indirect_reasons: Gun-cycle smoothing (dashes/light melee no longer pause the gun) and the tempo meta suit her snowball, and Diviner's Kevlar now adds ult CDR.
CC-heavy counters (Mo & Krill, Bebop) stay strong, capping her.
heroes.one_liner: Tempo gun-tank with a new anti-air bola; the patch is built for her.

direct_reasons: Seven direct nerfs: stamina cd 5->5.3, Light Eater lifesteal 20->18% (T3 +25->+22), Dazzling Trick cd 34->38s, Radiant Daggers T2 +80->+70, Shining Wonder radius 16.5->15.5m and T3 bounces +8->+6.
indirect_reasons: Radiant Regeneration and Restorative Locket trims hit her sustain core, and as a flyer she eats air-drag slows and Silver's grounding bola.
Tempo punishes her late-scaling spirit-burst profile.
build_changes: Witchmail's value rises as the anti-slow/CC answer now that slows bleed her air drag.
heroes.one_liner: Seven nerfs plus item and flyer hits drop the late-scaling spirit burst carry.
